items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: And some people come all the way from Russia, you know, on account of Clive Barnes or Walter Kerr.

ctx.x: And -- but the only thing about it is by us moving, they should have publicized it or broadcast it that the show had done this and done that, and was renamed, you know. The Village Voice -- I think they was the first one that did it. See, there was a gold mine, see. And some people come all the way from Russia, you know, on account of Clive Barnes or Walter Kerr. (unintelligible). One of them, you know. And this -- he used to be a colleague of you know the one that started the cancer fund? (unintelligible) and --…

So, he said he was going to start the ball rolling, which he did. He told all the other newspapers and so forth, because he was a big-time writer. So, anyhow, the public had to reinstate themselves when they found out -- they started to coming again.
